fusions.name: Rehearsed Salvo
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after each volley. It holds 4 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Final Correction
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt at a target at or below 30% health that deals 22 damage and leaves it [Spell Impetus] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Practiced Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Well-Rehearsed
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 6%.
